notes.title: Voice narration update!
notes.content:
Hello friends!

Thank you for being part of our community!

We are pleased to announce that we have added a wonderful, atmospheric voiceover done by famous actors to the gameplay of our game. Also some new wonderful visual effects were added.

Here are some samples:

http://aelgames.com/Narration/HowDoesItFeel.mp3
http://aelgames.com/Narration/NotSoFast!.mp3

Have a good game!

Not everything is voiced yet. We are working on completion. But you can already enjoy the result. ːsteamhappyː

Friends ːsteamhappyː, we will be very grateful if you repost this news. You will greatly help us to inform Steam players of our game. It’s very easy. Just click green ːsteamhappyː ‘Share’ ːsteamhappyː button at the bottom of this announcement and select where you would like repost the information about our game to. 

Our team would be very grateful for your help! ːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyː
